auditor.name: M/s. ARVP & Co. Chartered Accountants
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: The Company has not obtained an actuarial valuation in respect of its employee benefit obligations as required under Ind AS 19 – Employee Benefits. Consequently, the Company has not recognised a provision for such obligations in the accompanying standalone financial statements. The impact of the same on the standalone financial statements for the year ended 31st March 2026 could not be ascertained.

key_risks: Industry & Services Risk: Economic risks like demand and supply chain, profitability, gestation period; services risk like infrastructure facilities; market risk like consumer preferences and distribution channel; business dynamics like inflation/deflation; competition risks like cost effectiveness.
Fragmentation of the value chain, relatively small scale of operations, higher logistics and input costs, limited technology adoption and skill gaps.
Dependence on cotton while global demand shifts to man-made fibre (MMF)-based products.
Intense competition from major textile-producing countries in export markets.
Evolving global trade policies and geopolitical uncertainties impacting international trade and export demand.
Increasing environmental and sustainability requirements in key export markets raising compliance, technology and investment requirements.
